ranked.headline: Energetic, dynamical and structural supervision is being fused into sequence foundation models
ranked.summary: New models attach MD, energy and 3D-geometry heads to protein, RNA and ligand language models, turning embeddings into mutation- and site-resolved predictors.

ranked.headline: Perturbation response models add structured priors while benchmarks probe their limits
ranked.summary: New models for unseen genetic and chemical perturbations arrive alongside analyses of prior quality and cross-dataset concordance of drug responses.

ranked.headline: Hypothesis tests decide whether single-cell and spatial partitions are real
ranked.summary: SigDoTS and ProClust add formal significance testing to spatial domains and scRNA-seq clusters, merging overclustered groups instead of trusting heuristics.

ranked.headline: Binder and ligand generators move toward multi-objective, multi-variant design targets
ranked.summary: New generative models optimize paratopes across antigen variants, model all-atom contacts, and enforce cross-component constraints in conjugates and pockets.

ranked.headline: Quantifying how gene regulation reorganizes across tissue states, chromatin and disease
ranked.summary: Recent preprints quantify regulatory change across states: super-enhancer rewiring, liver zonation loss, senescence drivers and tumor pathway deregulation.

ranked.headline: Structured and interpretable models extend single-cell and spatial data to cell types, brain, and disease
ranked.summary: New spatial and multiome models infer domains, interfaces, and regulators directly from molecular data, while cohort-scale models link cell programs to disease.

ranked.headline: Biomolecular language models are paired with structure and stress-tested for validity and calibration
ranked.summary: Recent preprints probe where protein and molecular models fail, from relabeling-sensitive contacts to delta-level perturbation metrics, while adding calibration and structure.

ranked.headline: Long-read assemblies, pangenome decomposition and mobile element catalogues resolve pathogen genome content
ranked.summary: New resources and methods expand accessory-genome and surveillance coverage while long-read assemblies resolve complete P. falciparum field genomes.

ranked.headline: Single-cell methods borrow structure across modalities and models to assign clones and cell identities
ranked.summary: KLONE links scRNA-seq cells to scDNA-seq copy-number clones, while ensemble, transformer and distillation methods push cell-type and population labeling.

ranked.headline: Histology guides recovery of unmeasured gene expression in 2D and 3D spatial transcriptomics
ranked.summary: New preprints use histology to extend sparse spatial transcriptomics into continuous 3D fields, 1,000-gene panels, and single-cell profiles.

ranked.headline: Structure-linked annotation databases expand content and add machine-actionable access
ranked.summary: Six database updates pair added structural and annotation content with versioned APIs, MCP servers or workflows, enabling programmatic and agentic querying.

ranked.headline: Models link biophysical constraints to emergent circuit dynamics from dendrites to visual cortex
ranked.summary: Four new studies tie dendritic, spiking and connectome constraints to network dynamics, showing that matched tuning or outputs can hide distinct underlying regimes.

ranked.headline: Generative and enhanced-sampling methods map conformational ensembles and binding modes of biomolecules
ranked.summary: Preprints pair generative models with MD, enhanced sampling and latent-space analysis to resolve multimodal ensembles and rare transitions beyond single structures.

ranked.headline: Cohort-scale omics atlases pair with models of mutational and prognostic structure
ranked.summary: New atlases and models, from PANGEA to CCGA and MOTET, tie large harmonized omics cohorts to mutational processes, subtypes and survival.

ranked.headline: Connectome-constrained inferences are audited against unmeasured physiology and operation-induced functional error
ranked.summary: Two preprints stress-test connectome structure-function claims, auditing operations on C. elegans and tuning physiology fairly across Drosophila wirings.

ranked.headline: LLMs convert biomedical literature into structured toxicity evidence and knowledge bases
ranked.summary: LLM and RAG pipelines now mine full-text corpora into AOP evidence maps and a 189,212-finding hepatotoxicity knowledge base, alongside integrative graph resources.

ranked.headline: Multi-tissue, multi-species atlases resolve regulation at isoform and polyadenylation level
ranked.summary: New atlases in mouse, sheep, pig and long-read databases extend regulatory maps below the gene level and across tissues and species.

ranked.headline: Computational models link actomyosin filament mechanics and turnover to force transmission and tissue form
ranked.summary: Four November 2026 preprints apply mechanistic actomyosin models from cortex and perinuclear actin to cell contacts and wing disc morphogenesis.

ranked.headline: Updated omics databases link molecular profiles to regulatory, cellular, spatial and phenotypic context
ranked.summary: Seven database and tool releases extend omics resources with finer biological context, from miRNA TSSs and CpG markers to single-cell and spatial niches.

ranked.headline: Multi-genome comparisons are used to define gene content at alignment, orthogroup and family levels
ranked.summary: New tools and resources infer coding alignments, protein complex orthogroups and family trees across many genomes, plus a C. elegans annotation explorer.

ranked.headline: Curated multi-species resources extend noncoding RNA annotation and translation evidence
ranked.summary: Expanding cross-species RNA databases and a non-model bat genome assembly add genomic context and translation evidence for noncoding RNAs.

ranked.headline: Alignment-free and language-model methods for viral genome inference from reads
ranked.summary: Offline nanopore pipelines and genomic language model embeddings are making viral analysis tractable without full alignment or heavy computation.

ranked.headline: Analysis protocol choices can reverse conclusions in model-brain and EEG comparisons
ranked.summary: Preprints now treat analysis pipelines as tested variables, showing they can reverse model-brain and EEG group conclusions.

ranked.headline: Embedding validity checks into LLM and agent workflows for biological data analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints place assumption and identifiability checks inside LLM-assisted workflows, constraining which conclusions a pipeline can reach.

ranked.headline: Curated microbial metabolic resources link enzyme diversity to bacterial function
ranked.summary: Expanded metabolic models, pathway annotation, and enzyme prediction tools are updating how microbial genome-scale function is inferred from sequence.

ranked.headline: Dataset redundancy and label leakage distort evaluation of protein and gene embeddings
ranked.summary: Embedding-based annotation and classification benchmarks are being re-examined for label circularity, anisotropy, and non-redundant test sets.

ranked.headline: Single-cell multiomics map regulatory programs across basal ganglia and adult brain
ranked.summary: Joint chromatin and transcriptome profiling at single-cell resolution now spans human, mouse and primate basal ganglia, with population-level variation.

ranked.headline: Re-engineered pipelines for genomic, CRISPR, CLIP, and public metadata reanalysis
ranked.summary: Public omics archives and screening datasets are driving demand for faster, automated, single-command analysis tools that make reanalysis practical.

ranked.headline: Sensory-realistic and memory-structured models align with neural and behavioral data
ranked.summary: Quantitative benchmarking of computational models against behavioral and neural recordings is now central across recent preprints and a published study.

ranked.headline: Peptide ADMET evidence and multimodal prediction meet auditable evaluation standards
ranked.summary: Poor permeability and limited in vivo stability still decide whether peptide candidates reach the clinic, driving new ADMET resources and models.

ranked.headline: Inferring interaction-driven cell dynamics from single-cell and spatial transcriptomics
ranked.summary: Time-resolved and snapshot spatial data now allow learning explicit cell-cell interaction terms within inferred cell dynamics, including nonreciprocal couplings.

ranked.headline: Hybrid mechanistic and learned models advance quantitative forecasting of pathogen spread
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications extend forecasting with memory terms, simulation-informed training, and sequence-derived features.

ranked.headline: Repurposing pretrained generative models for out-of-scope biomolecular design tasks
ranked.summary: Pretrained generative models are being reused beyond their original scope for protein complexes, DNA restoration, and molecular inference.

ranked.headline: Count-based and sequence models map regulatory variant effects across cell types
ranked.summary: Donor-level expression and chromatin data now support genetic effect models that capture cell-type structure and noncoding variant impact.

ranked.headline: Scoring predicted protein complex geometry for glycan poses and membrane bilayers
ranked.summary: Structure-based ligand modeling depends on pose and complex geometry that predicted models may not reliably capture.

ranked.headline: Isoform atlases and multiomics databases map plant transcriptional regulation
ranked.summary: Population-scale isoform atlases and updated multiomics regulatory databases now link transcript variation and cis-elements to plant traits.

ranked.headline: Generative and causal models target biomedical counterfactuals where intervention is costly
ranked.summary: Observational and single-cell datasets demand counterfactual estimates that handle confounding and separate technical from biological variation.

ranked.headline: Gene-level and neighborhood-level inference methods for spatial omics datasets
ranked.summary: Recent papers and preprints target fast querying, multiscale statistics, and gene-relationship inference directly on spatial omics data.

ranked.headline: Polymer models link chromosome structure, loop extrusion and looping measurements
ranked.summary: Polymer simulations now infer chromosome dynamics from Hi-C and test how well microscopy and single-molecule readouts constrain chromatin looping.

ranked.headline: Specialized indexes and hardware accelerate k-mer, off-target, and nanopore workloads
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and journal articles report seeding, indexing, and compression designs matched to specific bottlenecks in sequence analysis.
